mostWorthwhile.text: Getting the membrane pump working was worthwhile: installing it first made its job and use of ATP easier to picture.

leastWorthwhile.text: Trying ATP directly with the pump was frustrating because the ATP picture pointed to the pump, but the result did not explain that the pump needed a membrane first.

surprise.text: I was surprised that ATP could not combine directly with the pump; fitting the pump into the membrane first made the pairing work.

arbitrary.text: The membrane prerequisite initially felt unclear because the ATP arrow suggested a direct pairing. The pump-spanning picture helped explain it afterward.
